additions.successor_review: Reviewed the original council summary, dates, document index, related applications and linked property history through November 11. The application remains Granted, with no later displayed decision or discharge record. Appeal status is Not Available, which is not proof that no challenge exists. Era4's October 16 release says design and construction plans are forthcoming. Its current news list and Valencia's press index provide no later supported physical-status change in the bounded search. Retain the October 15 issued-permission date; no construction or operation is inferred.
